metadata.title: Guideline 1 Application — Architecture & Design Prompt Authoring
metadata.author: Denis
metadata.purpose: Author a reusable LLM prompt that drives the full three-phase 'Decision → Validated ADR' workflow from Guideline 1 (Architecture & Design) of the team's Design Guidelines, using the post-ambiguity Milestone 1 spec as binding input.

conversation.content: Look at the Guidelines_Design.md, SPEC_M1.md and AMBIGUITY_LOG.md. Create a ARCHITECTURE_PROMPT_v1.md in guidelines/ for Guideline 1: Architecture & Design based on them.

conversation.summary: Read Guidelines_Design.md (Guideline 1 — three-phase ADR workflow), SPEC_M1.md (v2.0, ambiguity-resolved baseline), AMBIGUITY_LOG.md (8 closed items), the existing REQUIREMENTS_PROMPT_v1.md (to match house style), the prompts/ folder (for export-format precedent) and README.md (Design owners = Richard + Denis). Then authored guidelines/ARCHITECTURE_PROMPT_v1.md.
design_decisions: Mirrored the structure of REQUIREMENTS_PROMPT_v1.md (Role → Context → Task → Specific Deliverables → Raw Input) for consistency across guideline-application prompts.

Encoded Guideline 1's three phases as three explicit personas within a single prompt (Solution Architect → Development Architect → Senior Reviewing Architect) so an LLM cannot collapse them into a summary.
Embedded a verbatim ADR template and a strict JSON schema for design solutions, so outputs from successive runs are structurally comparable and reviewable.

Translated the 7 closed ambiguities into a binding 'architectural implications' table — most notably AMB-07 (no code duplication → configuration-driven engine, not a Classic/Duo fork) as the strongest M2-readiness driver.
Mandated requirement traceability: every architectural decision must cite an FR-/NFR-/SC-/IR- ID; untraceable claims are explicitly rejected.
Added an explicit stop-condition list of required artifacts so an incomplete response is detectable by the human reviewer.
Required architecture to be language-neutral but expressible in both Java/Maven and Python/uv (per NFR-2.1).

artifact.purpose: Single prompt to be pasted into a state-of-the-art LLM (Guideline 4) to execute Guideline 1 end-to-end against the Milestone 1 SRS.
phases_covered: Phase 1 — Select an Architecture (Decision Frame, ≥3 candidates, criteria comparison table, per-option ADRs, final ADR with rejection rationale)

Phase 2 — Refine into a Concrete Design (LLM role restated, 3 design solutions per architecture using GoF patterns, strict JSON output, human-review checklist, 9-row rating table, updated final ADR, Senior Architect review pass)

Phase 3 — Validate the Decision (Decision Basis Audit, quality-attribute scenarios contrasted with rejected alternatives, Drift Risk register with tripwires, Final Review Brief separating Valid / Questionable / Follow-up)

conversation.summary: Wrote this JSON file (prompts/denis_adr_prompt.json) capturing the conversation, the design rationale behind ARCHITECTURE_PROMPT_v1.md, and pointers to all referenced inputs and produced artifacts. Format follows the precedent set by richard_ambiguity_log_creation_sonnet_chat.json.

downstream_usage.intended_consumer: A state-of-the-art LLM (per Guideline 4 — Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.5–4.6, GPT-5.2/4, or Gemini 3 Pro).
expected_outputs: Updated final ADR after Phase 2 selection
downstream_usage.human_in_the_loop: The human architect (Richard / Denis) makes the final call. The LLM output is analytical scaffolding, not a decision.
